attempts.notes: Fixed the inline-assembly `if ... else` construct, which is not valid in Yul (assembly `if` has no `else` branch); replaced it with a `switch`/`case`/`default`. No other changes were needed.

Replaced `!(0x1f & length)` with `(0x1f & length) == 0` (uint256 has no `!`); casted the `0x20` literal to `uint256` in both `abi.encodePacked` calls; hoisted the mask expression into a `uint256` variable for clarity.

The assembly `if ... else` construct is invalid in Yul (if has no else branch); replaced with `switch/case/default`. Also replaced `!(0x1f & length)` with a boolean comparison, since `!` requires a bool operand in Solidity, and moved the mask computation into a typed variable.
Cast the literal 0x20 to uint256 in both abi.encodePacked calls; hoisted the mask expression into a typed uint256 local so packed encoding no longer sees untyped literals.
